items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: And they had a chorus line and Nichodems, that has the Ebony Avenue Workshop for Actors. [INTERVIEWER] Nichodems' Stewart Studio. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah. He was in the show.

ctx.x: Shuffle Along to town with the Shuffalong Show. That was Flournoy Miller and Mantan Moreland. They had the show. And they had a chorus line and Nichodems, that has the Ebony Avenue Workshop for Actors.

Yeah. He was in the show. And Olivette Miller, who was Flournoy Miller's daughter, playing the harp as a specialty in the act. And if she could play harp, I can. At that time, you know, as a novice. But she learned a little. But I heard great harpists, you know, out of studios. And comparing her with them, you know, was just about where she stood. I'm sorry to say it, but it was her shortcomings, you know, not mine. Ain't my job. (laughs)
